stimulus: Welcome! Please press any key to begin.

You are about to learn a language, traditionally spoken by the Tany people, called Taneg.

By now, speakers of Taneg are in the minority. About 20% of the population speaks it regularly, including some children, but everyone also speaks English.

Press any key to continue.

This is an important moment.

Minority languages like this often die out, or are left with only a few enthusiasts keeping them alive.

The Tany people want to avoid this future for Taneg. Recording it for future generations is not enough; they think the only way to keep it alive is for people to learn and use the language.

Press any key to continue.

Today you’ll learn just a small part of the language.

You know that Taneg is quite different from English, so you’ll need to pay careful attention to how it works.

Press any key to continue.

Do your best to learn Taneg! If people don’t learn it, it could die out…

Press any key to continue.
